item.title: Google Ads for Local Businesses: Get Leads Without Waste
item.description: Google Ads can bring in ready-to-buy customers or quietly drain a small budget. This guide explains how local businesses can target the right searches, avoid wasted spend, and measure what actually produces leads.
item.content:encoded:
A small business can spend $15 a day on Google Ads and get a steady flow of calls, or spend the same amount and get almost nothing. The difference is rarely the budget. It is targeting, messaging, and tracking.

Start With a Realistic Budget

Choose a budget you can sustain for several weeks. Judging results after three days rarely tells you anything.

Use Negative Keywords to Stop Wasted Clicks

Negative keywords tell Google which searches you do not want.

Track Conversions or You Are Guessing

If you are not measuring calls and form submissions, you cannot tell what is working.
